scripts.prepare: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const D=String.fromCharCode(36);let root;try{root=cp.execSync('git rev-parse --show-toplevel',{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).toString().trim()}catch{process.exit(0)}const base=p.resolve('.husky'),dest=p.join(base,'_');cp.execSync('git config core.hooksPath '+p.relative(root,dest));fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(p.join(dest,'.gitignore'),'*');fs.copyFileSync(p.resolve('node_modules/husky/husky'),p.join(dest,'h'));for(const h of ['pre-commit','pre-merge-commit','prepare-commit-msg','commit-msg','post-commit','applypatch-msg','pre-applypatch','post-applypatch','pre-rebase','post-rewrite','post-checkout','post-merge','pre-push','pre-auto-gc']){fs.writeFileSync(p.join(dest,h),'#!/usr/bin/env sh\n. \"'+D+'(dirname \"'+D+'0\")/h\"\n',{mode:0o755})}console.log('husky: hooks installed in '+dest)"
